rules.topic: The builder block holds 1000000 RF internally (line 73) and accepts at most 20000 RF/t; costs per action (config defaults): 500 RF per block operation (builderRfPerOperation, line 79), 300 RF per liquid, 300 RF per quarried block, 50 RF per skipped block, 5000 RF per moved entity, 40000 RF per moved player

Quarry shape-card cost factors multiply the per-block quarry cost: silk-touch quarry x3.0, fortune quarry x2 (line 134), void quarry x0.5 (line 128); the base quarry speed is 8 (quarryBaseSpeed, line 157) and quarries chunkload their area by default (quarryChunkloads true, line 144)
Space chamber (the mover system that relocates whole block regions) areas are limited to 128 blocks per dimension by default config
